payload.title: Bootstrap the stack pipeline roles as one repeatable, documented, checked step (follow-up to PPY-b8cc79)
payload.description: Ryan 2026-11-05: the pipeline role stack (infra/pipeline/papyrus-stack-pipeline.yaml) is hand-applied and the requirement was local knowledge; a release failed on an out-of-date role. Deliver: infra/pipeline/bootstrap.sh (account assert, change set shown first, AWS_ACCOUNT_ID variable, verify, rerunnable); OIDC provider creatable by parameter; README/AGENTS/docs say it is required and when to re-run; stack-deploy.yml says when the deployed role is older than the template and names the command on a not-authorized failure; tests (duplicate Sid, docs note). Parent story: PPY-b8cc79.
